[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Tree with maximum cost** [CF 1092F · Tree with Maximum Cost](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1092/F){rating="1900"}

Compute the cost of the root directly, then **reroot**: moving from a parent $p$ to its child $c$ brings the $s_c$ weight in $c$'s subtree one step closer and the remaining $S - s_c$ one step farther, where $S$ is the total weight. So $\text{cost}(c) = \text{cost}(p) + S - 2 s_c$.

[Solved in full in @sec-test-p2-tree-cost.]{.card-link}

:::
